# External images: sources, licences and required credits

Downloaded 2026-10-02 from Wikimedia Commons as 1600 px renders. Only public-domain,
CC0 or CC BY(-SA) images are used. Every use must carry the credit line in its caption.
Do not use the CC BY-SA image in the paper (publishers' copyright forms conflict with share-alike);
report and slides are fine.
